action.action-desc: Mr. Meeks (for himself and Ms. Williams of Georgia) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Financial Services

form.official-title: To amend the National Housing Act to revise the treatment of student loan debt in the underwriting of FHA loans, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Making FHA Work for Borrowers with Student Debt Act of 2021.

section.header: Treatment of student loan debt being repaid
section.text: Section 203 of the National Housing Act (12 U.S.C. 1709) is amended by inserting after subsection (r) the following new subsection:

subsection.header: Treatment of student loan debt being repaid

paragraph.text: In determining eligibility of single-family mortgages, and mortgagors under such mortgages, for insurance under this title, for purposes of any calculation of the amount of liabilities of a mortgagor, or comparison of the amount of such liabilities to the income of the mortgagor, the Secretary shall consider a covered educational liability to be—

subparagraph.text: except as provided in subparagraph (B), in the same monthly amount as the amount that the mortgagor is actually required to pay on a monthly basis in connection with such liability; or
in the case of a mortgagor whose required monthly payment under such liability is $0, the amount equal to 0.5 percent of the outstanding balance of the loan in connection with such liability.

paragraph.text: For purposes of this subsection, the term covered educational liability means a liability—

subparagraph.text: that is a student loan incurred for educational purposes;
that is required to be repaid through payments made on a regular basis; and
for which documentation has been provided that is sufficient, in the determination of the Secretary, to demonstrate that the liability complies with the requirements under subparagraphs (A) and (B).
